globalSettings.negativePromptCommon: text, letters, Korean characters, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermarks, chalk writing, calligraphy, labels, extra characters, extra teachers, 3D render, photorealistic, adult-realistic body proportions, changed eye color, missing gat, missing red tassels, distorted hands, deformed face, blurry, low quality
globalSettings.compositionRule: Keep Seolmin as the same 2D chibi Korean teacher from characters/seolmin/Seolmin.png. Keep the teacher on the right quarter and keep the chalkboard empty on the left three-quarters for later typography.

providerExpectations.keyframeGate: Approve all five Seolmin keyframes before any scene video generation begins.
providerExpectations.pictureStage: Generate mute picture-only clips first, then hand off for picture lock, dub, and typography.
providerExpectations.continuityRule: Scene 1 starts from approved keyframe 01; scenes 2-5 start from the previous scene final frame and aim toward the approved next keyframe pose card.
providerExpectations.textRule: Do not bake Korean, romanization, English prompts, answer text, CTA, subtitles, logos, watermarks, chalk writing, or any readable text into generated frames.
providerExpectations.styleRule: Use characters/seolmin as the visual canon. Preserve reference-only mode; do not create character LoRA, new canon, or a redesigned Seolmin identity.
providerExpectations.sceneDelivery: Each completed scene should yield one picture clip, one provider manifest, and one extracted last-frame asset for the next scene handoff.

_note: EDIT-stage handoff only. Preserve daehan-pilot-codex-003 order: greeting -> lesson sentence -> repeat -> blank quiz -> ending. Lesson lock: 학교 / 학교 앞에서 친구를 만납니다. Render, dubbing, typography, QA, and publish are downstream tasks.
